firmware.name: Touch String
firmware.author: Synthux Academy
firmware.description: Polyphonic physical modelling string synthesizer: pluck or bow seven strings, with an arpeggiator.
firmware.notes:
## Touch String
Source: [Synthux-Academy/TouchString](https://github.com/Synthux-Academy/TouchString).

## Pads
- **P03–P09** · strings 1–7 (velocity and pressure sensitive)
- **P00 / P02** · keyboard octave down / up (to ±2); tap both to reset
- **P01** · dampen: squeeze to palm-mute, tap to silence
- **P10** · tap in rhythm for tempo (40–240 BPM)
- **P10 + P00 / P02** · tempo −10 / +10 BPM
- **P10 + P03** · external MIDI clock on / off
- **P11 + P00 / P02** · previous / next scale
- **P11 + P03–P09** · pick a scale directly
- **P11 + P01** · poly / mono
- **P10 + P11**, hold ½ s · recalibrate the pads

## Switches
- **S09-S10 (exciter)** · left bow, centre pluck + bow on hold, right pluck
- **S07-S08 (arpeggiator)** · up latched, centre momentary, down off

## MIDI CC
| CC | Control |
|---|---|
| 70 | S30 brightness |
| 71 | S31 pitch |
| 72 | S32 timbre |
| 73 | S33 density |
| 74 | S34 notes |
| 75 | S35 string |
| 76 | S37 damp |
| 77 | reverb mix |
| 78 | pattern shift |
| 79 | S36 drive / volume |
